Hon'ble Shri Justice Ravindra Kumar Agrawal Order on Board 10/01/2025 1.
Heard on I.A. No. 1 of 2024 which is an application for condonation of delay in filing the application for restoration of MAC No. 72 of 2017.
2. On due consideration and for the reasons mentioned in the application, same is allowed.
The delay of 23 days in filing the application is condoned.
3. Also heard on the application for restoration of MAC No. 72 of 2017.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants would submit that due to some unavoidable circumstances he could not appear before this court at the time when the matter was called up for hearing.
The matter pertains to the compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act.
Therefore, the MAC No. 72 of 2017 may be restored in its original number.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 opposes.
6. On due consideration and for the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
Therefore, the MAC No. 72 of 2017 is restored to its original number.
7. Accordingly, the present MCC is disposed of.
